bestBets.overview: AUXILIARY brings some solid Fannie Bay form to Katherine. Won freeh then has not been beaten all that far in two runs since. Drawn to get right run and he can win this. LUNA FIELD is another that has consistent form. Placed in last couple and he can get away with this. VERBOSITY finished too well for impressive win at Fannie Bay last start beating the in-form Daniher. That form good enough for this while CHIEF WHITE SOCK bolted in at Alice Springs last start and this is not beyond him.

raceTips.comment: Luna Field draws best and should settle on speed from there. He has been good either side of a plain showing and the step up in trip looks suitable. Auxiliary also looks suited dropping back in trip and has a great racing pattern. He maps to settle on speed and should give a sight.

bestBets.overview: GALAXY GENERAL was disappointing when beaten favourite at Fannie Bay last start, but he had been racing well prior and can bounce back in this field. FIELD OF PRAISE started big odds last start but she ran a super race to just miss in a driving finish. Drawn perfectly and she gets her chance to go one better. ONLY THE BEST was just out of the placings in the small field at Pioneer Park last start. Finds similar and must consider while FORGETABOUTIT was beaten less than a length at Fannie Bay last start and if he produces similar he will give this a shake.

raceTips.comment: Snappy Sweetheart ran an improved race last start, sticking on better late. Drawn best, she should find the front and will give a good sight. Galaxy General comes out of some good form races and will find this easier.

bestBets.overview: FLASH KERMY is ready to win her maiden. Placed in her last two starts at Darwin and she finds right race to finally join the winners stall. ZOUTARA was well supported atr Fannie Bay last start but she was disappointing. She will be better from that outing and can get away with this. NATALIE JOY was beaten less than a length at Darwin two starts back before poor effort last start. Looking for her to bounce back in this while OPULENT OSCAR comes into this ready third-up. Not threatened in two runs back but must consider.

raceTips.comment: Flash Kermy looks ready to break through with two second placings in her last two runs. Drawn well, she has tactical speed and maps for the ideal run. Looks well placed here. Natalie Joy was good two starts ago when sitting on speed, but then was poor last start, coming under pressure early in the run. If she can recapture her form from first up she is right in this. Opulent Oscar will likely be spotting his key rivals a start, but he found the line well last start and should be charging home late again.

bestBets.overview: PRESS EXPRESS battled on well enough to be just out of placings at Darwin last start. Can mix her form but if she finds best in this field she should get very close. YAKI ISHI only just missed in a driving finish at Darwin last start. He should get a nice run in behind the speed and would include in winning chances. BRAZEN SAILOR comes into this off a string of placings at Pioneer Park. Awkward barrier but cannot leave out while ANECDOTAL was too bad to be true last start after wide run. Had been racing well prior and must include.

raceTips.comment: Frawley finally showed some tactical speed for Phillip Cole last start and that resulted in an improved showing. Drawn well and with Lek Maloney taking over, he looks well placed here. Anecdotal was planted wide last start and dropped out early. With less pressure here, he maps to find the front and can improve off that. Brazen Sailor is likely to settle close to last from the wide draw but has been racing well of late and should be flying home at the end.

bestBets.overview: I LOVERAIN was placed at Fannie Bay two starts back then held ground last start. Has the advantage of apprentice claim and he goes on top in this. MIAMI BABY started favourite two starts back but just held ground then he was not beaten all that far last start. That form good for this. ARIARNE battled on well enough when not far out of placings at Fannie Bay. She can sneak a minor spot in this while OKESUTORA has been consistent without threatening at Pioneer Park of late and he can fill a first four spot.

raceTips.comment: I Loverain was good two starts ago before leading them up last start and just weakening late. He had to work early to find the front and stuck on well enough considering that. He beat home Kessler who also settled on speed, albeit wide. With less pressure, Kessler can improve and should give a sight. Miami Baby will likely settle last and be closing off late.

bestBets.overview: UNQUESTIONABLY was beaten just on a length in a nice race at Darwin last start. He has been threatening to return to winners stall and will not get a better chance than this. ROCK REVOLUTION was placed three back then in the betting last couple but been disappointing. Drawn ideally and cannot leave out. VILLA SEVENTYNINE was a distant placing two back before poor effort last start. He is a must for exotics while THE ACCELATOR won with something in hand at Fannie Bay last start and no reason he cannot win again.

raceTips.comment: Unquestionably was good last start behind the smart Maldini. That is the superior form and he has been racing well of late. The step back in trip must be a knock, but happy to side with him on top. The Accelator was dominant in victory last start. Jade Hampson was having a day out and rode him to success and now Stan takes over. Rock Revolution maps to find the front and should give a sight but needs to improve.

bestBets.overview: VENTING was strong winning the Metric Mile two starts back then just did not run out the 2050m of the Darwin Cup and finished out the back. Back to the mile and can win the Cup. CAPITOL HILL placed behind Fury two starts back then just missed placings last start. Racing well enough for this. HOTIM ENGLISH only just missed behind the smart Maldini at Fannie Bay last start. Only needs to hold that form and he can go one better while THE GIRLS BOY won a nice race at Darwin three back and if he can produce similar would give this a shake.

raceTips.comment: Venting was planted wide and never in it last start. He was impressive two starts ago, coming from way back in running to win. He will need luck, but has a good record in Katherine and should find this easier. Capitol Hill draws wide but should settle in the first half of the field and be afforded every chance in running. Prince Joffa can improve with a positive ride from the inside gate.
